chapter: The Dallas nightclub and Jesse Stone's band
title: Call from T. H. Smith to the first Black nightclub in Dallas
summary: T. H. Smith, a real-estate man, calls the Johnsons home to join the band at the new North Dallas Club.

bands.name: Eugene Coy and His Happy Black Aces

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Okay, so we became great friends, and so we were there kind of sort of stranded, only we had -- we were in the Eugene Coy's hometown, so we really didn't have to worry about getting to a few grits and the hotel bill being paid, because he took on that responsibility.
However, while we were there we got a call from Dallas, Texas, long distance, my brother and I. We were still together, me and Keg --
With Eugene Coy's band, and we got a

call from Dallas, Texas from a man by the name of T. H. Smith. Now T. H. Smith was a very rich real estate man, and he owned the North Dallas club. Milt, I'm sure you're familiar with the North Dallas Club.
Well, they called us there because they were opening the first black night club in Dallas, Texas, and they wanted the Johnson boys there in the band. Well, naturally we accepted.
